defects.catch_criteria: In scripts/bundle-asset-patch.ts, `relativeAssetBindingPattern` (used by `unrewrittenAssetBindings`) and `assetBindingPattern` match only identifiers that end exactly in `_default`, but Bun numbers the identifier when two file assets share a basename (`highlights_default2 = "./highlights-<hash>.scm"`), so such a binding is neither rewritten nor reported and the build guard in scripts/build-binary.ts passes. A review catches it only if it says that suffixed or numbered `_default` bindings (basename collisions) escape the pattern, which makes the claim that the guard catches every relative file-asset binding false.
defects.title: Reject Bun's numbered asset bindings too
